```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "ts_pack.h"

int main(void) {
    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"chatito\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("%[greeting]\n    hello", config_handle);
    ts_pack_process_config_free(config_handle);

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
```
